verses.en: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.pt: Filho meu, guarda as minhas palavras, e entesoura contigo os meus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
verses.en_bbe: My son, keep my sayings, and let my rules be stored up with you.

verses.en: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.pt: Observa os meus mandamentos e vive; guarda a minha lei, como a menina dos teus olhos.
verses.en_web: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
verses.en_bbe: Keep my rules and you will have life; let my teaching be to you as the light of your eyes;

verses.en: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
verses.pt: Ata-os aos teus dedos, escreve-os na tábua do teu coração.
verses.en_web: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.en_bbe: Let them be fixed to your fingers, and recorded in your heart.

verses.en: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
verses.pt: Dize à sabedoria: Tu és minha irmã; e chama ao entendimento teu amigo íntimo,
verses.en_web: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
verses.en_bbe: Say to wisdom, You are my sister; let knowledge be named your special friend:

verses.en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
verses.pt: para te guardarem da mulher alheia, da adúltera, que lisonjeia com as suas palavras.
verses.en_web: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
verses.en_bbe: So that they may keep you from the strange woman, even from her whose words are smooth.

verses.en: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
verses.pt: Porque da janela da minha casa, por minhas grades olhando eu,
verses.en_web: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
verses.en_bbe: Looking out from my house, and watching through the window,

verses.en: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
verses.pt: vi entre os simples, divisei entre os jovens, um mancebo falto de juízo,
verses.en_web: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
verses.en_bbe: I saw among the young men one without sense,

verses.en: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.pt: que passava pela rua junto à esquina da mulher adúltera e que seguia o caminho da sua casa,
verses.en_web: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
verses.en_bbe: Walking in the street near the turn of her road, going on the way to her house,

verses.en: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
verses.pt: no crepúsculo, à tarde do dia, à noite fechada e na escuridão;
verses.en_web: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
verses.en_bbe: At nightfall, in the evening of the day, in the black dark of the night.

verses.en: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
verses.pt: e eis que uma mulher lhe saiu ao encontro, ornada à moda das prostitutas, e astuta de coração.
verses.en_web: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
verses.en_bbe: And the woman came out to him, in the dress of a loose woman, with a designing heart;

verses.en: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
verses.pt: Ela é turbulenta e obstinada; não param em casa os seus pés;
verses.en_web: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
verses.en_bbe: She is full of noise and uncontrolled; her feet keep not in her house.

verses.en: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.pt: ora está ela pelas ruas, ora pelas praças, espreitando por todos os cantos.
verses.en_web: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
verses.en_bbe: Now she is in the street, now in the open spaces, waiting at every turning of the road.

verses.en: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
verses.pt: Pegou dele, pois, e o beijou; e com semblante impudico lhe disse:
verses.en_web: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
verses.en_bbe: So she took him by his hand, kissing him, and without a sign of shame she said to him:

verses.en: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
verses.pt: Sacrifícios pacíficos tenho comigo; hoje paguei os meus votos.
verses.en_web: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
verses.en_bbe: I have a feast of peace-offerings, for today my oaths have been effected.

verses.en: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.pt: Por isso saí ao teu encontro a buscar-te diligentemente, e te achei.
verses.en_web: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
verses.en_bbe: So I came out in the hope of meeting you, looking for you with care, and now I have you.

verses.en: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
verses.pt: Já cobri a minha cama de cobertas, de colchas de linho do Egito.
verses.en_web: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: My bed is covered with cushions of needlework, with coloured cloths of the cotton thread of Egypt;

verses.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.pt: Já perfumei o meu leito com mirra, aloés e cinamomo.
verses.en_web: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.en_bbe: I have made my bed sweet with perfumes and spices.

verses.en: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.pt: Vem, saciemo-nos de amores até pela manhã; alegremo-nos com amores.
verses.en_web: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
verses.en_bbe: Come, let us take our pleasure in love till the morning, having joy in love's delights.

verses.en: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.pt: Porque meu marido não está em casa; foi fazer uma jornada ao longe;
verses.en_web: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
verses.en_bbe: For the master of the house is away on a long journey:

verses.en: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
verses.pt: um saquitel de dinheiro levou na mão; só lá para o dia da lua cheia voltará para casa.
verses.en_web: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
verses.en_bbe: He has taken a bag of money with him; he is coming back at the full moon.

verses.en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
verses.pt: Ela o faz ceder com a multidão das suas palavras sedutoras, com as lisonjas dos seus lábios o arrasta.
verses.en_web: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
verses.en_bbe: With her fair words she overcame him, forcing him with her smooth lips.

verses.en: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
verses.pt: Ele a segue logo, como boi que vai ao matadouro, e como o louco ao castigo das prisões;
verses.en_web: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
verses.en_bbe: The simple man goes after her, like an ox going to its death, like a roe pulled by a cord;

verses.en: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
verses.pt: até que uma flecha lhe atravesse o fígado, como a ave que se apressa para o laço, sem saber que está armado contra a sua vida.
verses.en_web: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
verses.en_bbe: Like a bird falling into a net; with no thought that his life is in danger, till an arrow goes into his side.

verses.en: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, filhos, ouvi-me, e estai atentos às palavras da minha boca.
verses.en_web: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: So now, my sons, give ear to me; give attention to the sayings of my mouth;

verses.en: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
verses.pt: Não se desvie para os seus caminhos o teu coração, e não andes perdido nas suas veredas.
verses.en_web: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
verses.en_bbe: Let not your heart be turned to her ways, do not go wandering in her footsteps.

verses.en: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
verses.pt: Porque ela a muitos tem feito cair feridos; e são muitíssimos os que por ela foram mortos.
verses.en_web: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
verses.en_bbe: For those wounded and made low by her are great in number; and all those who have come to their death through her are a great army.

verses.en: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.pt: Caminho de Seol é a sua casa, o qual desce às câmaras da morte.
verses.en_web: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
verses.en_bbe: Her house is the way to the underworld, going down to the rooms of death.
